title: Cold Storage Checklist
subtitle: Cold Storage Control: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Cold Storage Checklist covers storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition. The cold-storage operations owner records Cold Storage Control criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Cold Storage Checklist keeps Cold Storage Control exceptions visible until the cold-storage operations owner handoff.
use_case: Use Cold Storage Checklist at cooler, freezer, cold room, loading interface, and affected product zone. Document storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition identity before Cold Storage Control begins. Compare storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition findings with stated Cold Storage Control criteria; route unresolved Cold Storage Control issues to qualified product-condition reviewer. For Cold Storage Checklist, confirm requirements for Cold Storage Control. Ask qualified product-condition reviewer to review Cold Storage Control conditions beyond the cold-storage operations owner's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Cold Storage Control, identify responsible parties, cooler, freezer, cold room, loading interface, and affected product zone, and the linked storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition source.

fields.label: Product, lot, quantity, and storage requirement
Logger, sensor, probe, calibration, and alarm

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Cold Storage Control facts for storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Cold Storage Control inspection checks
items: Door, seal, traffic, and loading event

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Before closing Cold Storage Control, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Cold-Storage Operations Owner preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Product moved or released without qualified disposition
blocks.guidance: Pause Cold Storage Control when temperature history, device reliability, affected scope, containment, or qualified product disposition remains unresolved. Retain the available Cold Storage Control proof and route unresolved storage room, zone, product lot, monitoring device, door event, alarm, and disposition scope to cold-storage operations owner.
